message.content:
Artificial Christmas trees are classified in HTSUS subheading 9505.10 (Christmas festive articles). The subheading 9505.10.25 covers "Artificial Christmas trees," and the statistical suffix is 9505.10.2500 for artificial Christmas trees. Older versions had 9505.10.25 split into "Artificial Christmas trees" at 9505.10.2500, and other at 9505.10.5000. Since the 2022 HTS revision, I believe 9505.10.25 remains for artificial Christmas trees, with the 10-digit being 9505.10.2500. Note that CBP rulings on PVC trees cite 9505.10.2500 and, for non-PVC, 9505.10.3000 or similar, but PVC trees usually still fall under 9505.10.25.

{"hts_code": "9505.10.2500", "reason": "A tabletop artificial Christmas tree with PVC branches, sold solely as a Christmas decoration, is a festive article of heading 9505 and falls under the artificial Christmas trees provision of subheading 9505.10.25."}
